observations: Photo 0: A hand holds a black Nikon DSLR camera with a lens attached. The word 'Nikon' is visible on the top of the camera body. The lens has a front cap and a textured barrel. The background shows a white ceiling with recessed lighting and a wall with a marble-patterned panel.

Photo 1: The same camera is shown from a different angle, held up to the lens. The lens barrel clearly shows 'NIKON' and '18-55mm' printed on it. The camera body has 'Nikon' on the top. The background includes a white ceiling, a door, and a fan.

Photo 2: The camera is shown from the back, with the LCD screen off. The word 'Nikon' is visible on the bottom of the camera body. The control buttons and dials are visible. The background is the same as in the other photos, with a white ceiling and a fan.
All photos have a watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI NWOKE BRIGHT'.

claims.claim: Capture beautiful photos and videos with this Nikon D60 DSLR camera
claims.evidence: The camera is identified as a Nikon DSLR, but the model is not visible. The claim about 'beautiful photos and videos' cannot be verified from the photos alone.
The term 'versatile' is vague and not verifiable from the photos. No accessories or additional items are shown to confirm the 'versatile' claim.

risks.risk: The camera may not be functional (e.g., lens not working, shutter failure, screen not working).
risks.proof: A video showing the camera powering on, taking a photo, and displaying the image on the screen.

risks.risk: The lens may be damaged or non-functional (e.g., scratches, fungus, internal damage).
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the lens front element and a video showing the lens focusing and changing aperture.

risks.risk: The camera may have internal damage or missing parts (e.g., battery, charger, strap, or accessories).
risks.proof: A photo showing the battery, charger, strap, and any included accessories.

risks.risk: The camera may be stolen or have a blacklisted serial number.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the serial number on the camera body (usually on the bottom or inside the battery compartment).

proof_requests: Photo of the sticker on the body showing the model name.
Photo of the serial number on the camera body.
Video showing the camera powering on, taking a photo, and displaying the image on the screen.
Close-up photo of the lens front element and a video showing the lens focusing and changing aperture.
Photo showing the battery, charger, strap, and any included accessories.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
